steps.title: Your own files
steps.body: Your game can use your own pictures, videos, sounds, 3D models and fonts. The Media library (File menu) lists them all: how much space they take, where each is used and who made it.

how.text: Open the File menu and choose Media library…

steps.title: Import a picture and a video
steps.body: Import files… takes pictures (.png .jpg .webp .gif .avif .bmp .svg), videos (.mp4 .webm), sounds, 3D models and fonts, up to 20 MB each. Each is measured: a picture's size, a video's length.
steps.task: Import a picture and a short video (yours, or Do it for me makes samples).

how.text: Press Import files… and pick a picture and a video from your computer.

do.say: A big poster and a 2-second video, made here.

steps.title: Who made it
steps.body: Pick a file and fill in Who made it: author, licence and a link. Files you didn't make need their maker's licence; a Credits widget lists them all.

how.text: Pick the poster, then type an Author and a Licence under Who made it.

steps.title: Make room
steps.body: The poster is wider than 2048 pixels: it is marked big. Shrink it makes a smaller copy and puts it everywhere the picture is used — Undo puts it back.

how.text: Press Shrink big pictures (or Shrink it on the poster).

steps.title: An intro video
steps.body: A Video widget plays a clip on a screen. Without Loop, its When it ends actions run: here the title screen shows and the intro closes. Click or Enter skips it.
steps.task: Make an Intro screen that plays the video, then shows the title.

how.text: In Screens, press + New, name it Intro, add a Video widget, pick the clip and add Show screen Title under When it ends.

do.say: An Intro screen with the video.

steps.title: Credits
steps.body: A Credits widget shows your own lines, then every credited file.
steps.task: Add a Credits widget to the Intro screen.

how.text: Under Add, click Credits; type your lines under Lines at the top.

steps.title: Your media, your game
steps.body: File › Media library has every imported file, its size and credit; Video and Credits widgets are under Add in Screens. Brix's Help has them (search “video” or “credits”).
